title: Normalized adjunction for literal finite-Tor restrictions
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$ and prime $\ell\ne p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], finite-type $k$-schemes $X,Y$, a separated finite-type $k$-map $f:X\to Y$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], a compactification $c$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and a positive finite coefficient stage $(E,n)$. Use the full categories $\mathcal C_T=D^b_{ctf}(T,A_{E,n})$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] and the fixed realization formulas of [def-sf-finite-operation-realizations]. Suppose $F:\mathcal C_X\to\mathcal C_Y$ and $G:\mathcal C_Y\to\mathcal C_X$ are literal restrictions of intrinsic support and the specified intrinsic exceptional functor: their composites with the full inclusions equal the ambient functors on objects and morphisms. There exist an additive integer-shift structure on $F$ and an adjunction $F\dashv G$, such that $F$ is triangulated, and, with exactly the adjoint integer-shift structure on $G$, the two prescribed realization isomorphisms commute with shifts. Every realized object is bounded below, every source object has an etale-origin witness, and for every such witness the realized adjunction Hom bijection is exactly the specified ordinary etale site-comparison Hom chain. This statement gives no preservation or uniform-bound assertion and does not construct $F$ or $G$.

source.place: Proposition 2.23; original lem-sf-exceptional-finite-operations steps 4--5; blueprint sk-thm-sf-tensor-hom, Complement.

proof.text: For every finite-Tor object, use its intrinsic constructibility and finite homology support in the finite-ring essential-image criterion. The resulting bounded constructible etale object lifts through the canonical coefficient equivalence to a fixed-module origin; exact comparison transports its lower bound. This proves all hX, hY and source origin assertions.

Expand the specified relative Hom chain. Lift any arrow between two origins by comparison full faithfulness. Naturality of the compact-support comparison and the two adjunction Hom equivalences gives left naturality for arbitrary origins and right naturality. Taking the identity arrow gives independence of origin.

Transport the relative Hom equivalence across rF, rG and the fully faithful coefficient realizations. Define the restricted bijections by these compositions, prove both naturality laws by faithfulness and cancellation of rG, and apply Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv. Change-of-origin naturality proves the required normalization for every retained origin.

Reflect additivity through the faithful realization. Lift the left shifts through rF with Functor.CommShift.ofComp; its compatibility theorem gives rF shift compatibility. Reflect distinguished triangles through the fully faithful triangulated realization. All ambient functors and realizations here have their existing derived structures.

Apply the strictly smaller normalized-right-realization shift lemma to the constructed adjunction, its normalization, and the proved boundedness/origin assertions. Package the result with the prescribed realization isomorphisms and all proved clauses.

theorem sfFiniteOperations_restrictedAdjunction (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (_hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f)
    (E : ConstructibleExceptionalCoefficients.FieldStage.{u} l) (n : ℕ+)
    (F : finiteTorConstructibleCategory l E.carrier n n.pos X ⥤
          finiteTorConstructibleCategory l E.carrier n n.pos Y)
      (G : finiteTorConstructibleCategory l E.carrier n n.pos Y ⥤
          finiteTorConstructibleCategory l E.carrier n n.pos X)
      (eF : F ⋙ (finiteTorConstructible l E.carrier n n.pos Y).ι =
        (finiteTorConstructible l E.carrier n n.pos X).ι ⋙
          sfIntrinsicCompactSupport c (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E.carrier n))
      (eG : G ⋙ (finiteTorConstructible l E.carrier n n.pos X).ι =
        (finiteTorConstructible l E.carrier n n.pos Y).ι ⋙
          sfFiniteOperationsIntrinsicRight l E n c) :
    ∃ (_ : F.Additive) (_ : F.CommShift ℤ) (adj : F ⊣ G),
    letI := adj.rightAdjointCommShift ℤ
    F.IsTriangulated ∧
      ∃ (rF : F ⋙ sfFiniteOperationsRealization l E n Y ≅
          sfFiniteOperationsRealization l E n X ⋙
            ProEtale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u}
                (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E.carrier n))) c)
        (rG : G ⋙ sfFiniteOperationsRealization l E n X ≅
          sfFiniteOperationsRealization l E n Y ⋙ ProEtale.sfFiniteExceptionalAt
            (ULift.{u + 1, u} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E.carrier n)) c)
        (hX : ∀ K : finiteTorConstructibleCategory l E.carrier n n.pos X,
          DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus ((sfFiniteOperationsRealization l E n X).obj K))
        (hY : ∀ L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory l E.carrier n n.pos Y,
          DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus ((sfFiniteOperationsRealization l E n Y).obj L)),
      rF = sfFiniteOperationsLeftRealization l E n c F eF ∧
      rG = sfFiniteOperationsRightRealization l E n c G eG ∧
      rF.hom.CommShift ℤ ∧ rG.hom.CommShift ℤ ∧
      (∀ K : finiteTorConstructibleCategory l E.carrier n n.pos X,
        Nonempty (FixedEtaleOriginWitness X
          (ULift.{u + 1, u} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E.carrier n))
          ⟨(sfFiniteOperationsRealization l E n X).obj K, hX K⟩)) ∧
      (∀ (K : finiteTorConstructibleCategory l E.carrier n n.pos X)
        (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory l E.carrier n n.pos Y)
        (W : FixedEtaleOriginWitness X
          (ULift.{u + 1, u} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E.carrier n))
          ⟨(sfFiniteOperationsRealization l E n X).obj K, hX K⟩) (a : F.obj K ⟶ L),
        (sfFiniteOperationsRealization l E n X).map (adj.homEquiv K L a) ≫ rG.hom.app L =
          sfFiniteOperationsHomEquiv l E n D.k (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k)) c
            ⟨(sfFiniteOperationsRealization l E n X).obj K, hX K⟩ W
            ⟨(sfFiniteOperationsRealization l E n Y).obj L, hY L⟩
            (rF.inv.app K ≫ (sfFiniteOperationsRealization l E n Y).map a))
